titulo: You were looking out the window. I looked too.
caption:
You were looking out the window. I looked too.

You were at the window. I walked three steps over and looked where you were looking.

Nobody asked me to. That is the whole behavior.

Send it to the friend who stares out the window and never says what at.

#Cella #relatable #friendship

Closer to yourself.

More behaviors: link in bio.
descripcion:
Three steps over. Same window. Same direction.

Looking at what someone else is looking at, without asking why, is a small way to say "I am here".

#Cella #relatable #friendship

NAOS · by NMR
#shorts
alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A deep navy room at night with a window of four panes on the wall with a crescent moon and twinkling stars and a dark plank floor. A light-blue block figure with sleepy eyes stands at the left and a amber block figure stands at the right looking up at the moon in the window. The light-blue figure notices, widens its eyes, walks three steps toward the amber one and looks up at the same window. Both end side by side, eyes happy and closed. The text, which appears after the first second: you, at the window. Then: me, looking where you look.
comentario_fijado: Who looks out the window with you?
